name: RawWeights
description: AI/ML technical education site for practitioners — interactive browser-based playgrounds, deep guides on RAG, LLMs, agentic systems, fine-tuning, and security, plus build stories from real AI products.

search.description: Full-text search across blog, guides, and usecases (Pagefind-powered)

companionFormat.description: Every HTML content page has a companion .md file at the same path with .html replaced by .md

shellTools.description: All pages register four tools via document.modelContext (Chrome 149+): search_rawweights, get_navigation, get_footer_links, get_page_sections
shellTools.perPageTools: Interactive playground pages declare additional domain-specific tools via window.RW_PAGE_TOOLS before the nav script loads
